description: CloudNativePG cluster health, per-instance status, Barman Cloud S3 backup storage by location, and PostgreSQL workload metrics.

panels.title: Cluster Status
panels.description: Overall readiness of selected PostgreSQL instances and metrics collectors.

panels.title: Instances Ready
panels.description: Number of ready PostgreSQL instance pods in the cluster.

panels.title: Max Replication Lag
panels.description: Highest replication lag across streaming standby instances.

panels.title: Transactions / s
panels.description: Committed and rolled-back transactions per second across selected instances.

panels.title: Active Connections
panels.description: Total client backend connections across selected instances.

panels.title: Total Database Size
panels.description: Combined on-disk size of all databases on the cluster.

panels.title: CPU vs Request
panels.description: Container CPU usage relative to requested CPU across selected instances.

panels.title: Memory vs Request
panels.description: Container memory working set relative to requested memory across selected instances.

panels.title: PVC Space Used
panels.description: Highest filesystem usage across instance PGDATA and WAL volumes.

panels.title: Last Base Backup
panels.description: Time elapsed since the most recent completed Barman Cloud base backup.

panels.title: Last Archived WAL
panels.description: Time elapsed since the primary archived its latest WAL segment.

panels.title: Total S3 Backup Size
panels.description: Total bytes stored across all configured S3 backup locations (base backups + WAL archive).

panels.title: PostgreSQL Instances
panels.description: Per-instance role, readiness, connections, resource utilization, PVC usage, transaction ID wraparound age, uptime, and PostgreSQL version.

panels.title: Total S3 Storage Used
panels.description: Combined storage used across all S3 backup locations.

panels.title: Base Backups Size
panels.description: Storage used by physical base backup tarballs across all S3 locations.

panels.title: WAL Archive Size
panels.description: Storage used by compressed WAL segments across all S3 locations.

panels.title: S3 Locations Reachable
panels.description: Number of configured S3 backup locations responding to ListObjectsV2.

panels.title: First Recoverability Point
panels.description: Earliest point in time to which the cluster can be restored.

panels.title: Last Failed Backup
panels.description: Timestamp of the last failed backup reported by Barman Cloud (None when 0).

panels.title: S3 Backup Locations
panels.description: Configured Barman Cloud S3 backup locations, their endpoints, retention windows, base backup count, and storage breakdown (Base vs WAL vs Total).

panels.title: Storage by S3 Location
panels.description: Comparison of total backup bytes stored on each S3 location.

panels.title: S3 Backup Storage Evolution
panels.description: Evolution of total backup storage and storage per S3 location over time.

panels.title: S3 Storage Breakdown (Base Backups vs WAL)
panels.description: Stacked storage evolution showing base backups versus archived WAL segments per S3 location.

panels.title: CPU Usage by Instance
panels.description: Container CPU usage in cores per PostgreSQL instance.

panels.title: Memory Working Set by Instance
panels.description: Container working set memory per PostgreSQL instance.

panels.title: Connections by State
panels.description: Backend sessions grouped by PostgreSQL connection state and instance.

panels.title: Transactions Rate (Commit vs Rollback)
panels.description: Per-instance rate of committed and rolled-back transactions.

panels.title: Longest Transaction & Blocked Queries
panels.description: Maximum active transaction duration and blocked backend count per instance.

panels.title: Tuple Activity (Insert / Update / Delete / Fetch)
panels.description: Rate of rows inserted, updated, deleted, and fetched across databases.

panels.title: Database Size by Database
panels.description: On-disk size of each logical PostgreSQL database over time.

panels.title: PVC Space & Inode Usage
panels.description: Filesystem space and inode utilization for instance PersistentVolumeClaims.

panels.title: Block I/O (Buffer Hits vs Disk Reads)
panels.description: Shared buffer cache hits versus physical disk block reads per second.

panels.title: WAL Segment Count & Archive Queue
panels.description: Total WAL segments on disk and WAL archive queue status (ready vs done).

panels.title: WAL Archiver Rate & Archive Age
panels.description: Rate of archived/failed WAL files and seconds since last WAL archival.

panels.title: Replication Lag (Write / Flush / Replay)
panels.description: Streaming replication write, flush, replay, and total lag in seconds.

panels.title: PostgreSQL Settings
panels.description: Active PostgreSQL runtime configuration parameters reported per instance.

panels.title: Installed Extensions
panels.description: PostgreSQL extensions installed across databases and whether an update is available.

panels.title: Ready Operator Pods
panels.description: Number of ready CloudNativePG controller manager pods.

panels.title: Cluster Reconcile Errors
panels.description: Total reconciliation errors logged by the cluster controller.

panels.title: Backup Reconcile Errors
panels.description: Total reconciliation errors logged by the backup controller.

panels.title: Scheduled Backup Errors
panels.description: Total reconciliation errors logged by the scheduled backup controller.

panels.title: Operator Reconcile Errors over Time
panels.description: Controller runtime reconciliation error counters across CNPG controllers.

panels.title: Checkpointer Write & Sync Time
panels.description: Cumulative checkpoint write and sync time in milliseconds.

list.name: operatorNamespace

list.description: Namespace where the PostgreSQL cluster runs
list.label: Database Namespace
